blocks.text: LOS ANGELES — The Emmy Awards that celebrate the best in television are the latest entertainment industry gala to ink a streaming deal, and will leave broadcast for Amazon Prime starting next year. The Television Academy on Tuesday, Oct. 6, announced the new six-year deal that will make the awards show available for streaming worldwide without a paywall on the Amazon platform. The 79th edition of the Emmys next September will see it become the first of the major EGOT awards — Emmys, Grammys, Oscars and Tonys — to exclusively stream.
